record.paper_title: Open Problems for Entire Functions of Bounded Index in Direction
record.original_question: Let L be a positive continuous function and use the bounded directional L-index definition: H has bounded L-index in direction c if the normalized directional derivatives |D_c^m H(z)|/(m! L(z)^m) are controlled, for all m and z, by finitely many orders 0 <= k <= m0. If g(z1,z2) is an entire function of bounded L-index in both directions b1 and b2, what positive function L* and direction b* ensure that an entire solution F of the mixed directional equation D_b1 D_b2 F(z1,z2) = g(z1,z2) has bounded L*-index in direction b*?

artifact.category_tag: Entire functions of bounded L-index in direction
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $L: \mathbb{C}^2 \to (0,\infty)$ be a positive continuous function and fix a nonzero direction $b \in \mathbb{C}^2$. For an entire function $H: \mathbb{C}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$, define the directional derivatives recursively by $D_b^0 H = H$ and $D_b^{m} H(z) = \langle \nabla D_b^{m-1} H(z), b \rangle$ for $m \geq 1$. The function $H$ is said to have bounded $L$-index in the direction $b$ if there exists a nonnegative integer $m_0$ such that for every $m \in \mathbb{N}_0$ and every $z \in \mathbb{C}^2$,
$$\frac{|D_b^m H(z)|}{m!\, L(z)^m} \leq \max_{0 \leq k \leq m_0} \frac{|D_b^k H(z)|}{k!\, L(z)^k}.$$
The least such $m_0$ is the $L$-index of $H$ in the direction $b$.

Suppose $g: \mathbb{C}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ is an entire function that has bounded $L$-index in the direction $b_1$ and also has bounded $L$-index in the direction $b_2$, where $b_1, b_2 \in \mathbb{C}^2 \setminus \{0\}$ are given. 

Determine a positive continuous function $L^*: \mathbb{C}^2 \to (0,\infty)$ and a nonzero direction $b^* \in \mathbb{C}^2$ (expressible in terms of $L$, $b_1$, $b_2$) such that every entire solution $F: \mathbb{C}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ of the mixed directional differential equation
$$D_{b_1} D_{b_2} F(z_1, z_2) = g(z_1, z_2)$$
necessarily has bounded $L^*$-index in the direction $b^*$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem comes from a list of open problems on entire functions of bounded L-index in a direction. Related work has resolved companion problems (e.g., for equations involving derivatives in a single direction, addressed by Bandura–Skaskiv and others), but no published solution to this mixed-directional version was located. The problem appears to still be open.

status_evidence.title: Slice holomorphic solutions of some directional differential equations with bounded L-index in the same direction
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses index boundedness of solutions for single-direction directional differential equations, leaving mixed-directional cases for further study.
status_evidence.claim: Related single-direction problems have been studied, but the mixed-directional formulation is not resolved there.

status_evidence.title: Slice Holomorphic Functions in Several Variables with Bounded L-Index in Direction
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys properties and open questions about bounded L-index in direction.
status_evidence.claim: Open problems concerning differential equations on functions of bounded L-index in direction remain a subject of ongoing research.
